content.title: EXTENDED HIGHLIGHTS | Tottenham v Brighton | Premier League
content.text: BHAFC Relaxed Backprint Tee - Deep Forest Green Brighton & Hove Albion FC A staple piece for any supporter's wardrobe, the BHAFC Relaxed Backprint Tee blends heritage flair with a modern fit. Cut from a soft forest green cotton, this short-sleeve t-shirt features a clean embroidered seagull logo on the chest and a signature branded hem-tag. The reverse makes a bold statement with a vibrant, vintage-inspired back print, making it an effortless choice for any occasion. Colour: Forest Green Size: Adult (XS-3XL) Relaxed fit Material: 100% Cotton Shop Brighton & Hove Albion FC BHAFC We Are Brighton Relaxed Tee - Indigo Blue Brighton & Hove Albion FC The BHAFC We Are Brighton Relaxed Tee features a standout back print graphic containing a yellow script slogan layered over repeating sand outlined text. Complete with a club crest, this t-shirt delivers both comfort and club style. Colour: Indigo Blue Size: Adult (XS-3XL) Relaxed fit Material: 100% Cotton Shop Brighton & Hove Albion FC BHAFC Goldstone Relaxed Tee - Offwhite White Brighton & Hove Albion FC A tribute to our roots, the BHAFC Goldstone Relaxed Tee in Off-White celebrates the legendary home of the Albion. Cut from soft cotton in a vintage cream tone, this short-sleeve tee features a detailed illustration of the iconic Goldstone Ground and a signature branded hem-tag. With its relaxed silhouette and heritage-inspired graphic, it's a timeless piece for fans who want to carry a piece of club history wherever they go. Colour: Off-white Size: Adult (XS-3XL) Relaxed fit Material: 100% Cotton Shop Brighton & Hove Albion FC BHAFC Classic Backprint Relaxed Tee - Blue Blue Brighton & Hove Albion FC A timeless staple, the BHAFC Classic Backprint Relaxed Tee blends heritage style with everyday comfort. Designed with soft blue cotton, this short-sleeve tee features a small embroidered seagull & BHAFC lettering, while the back makes a statement with a bold vintage-inspired print. Colour: Blue Size: Adult (XS-3XL) Relaxed fit Material: 100% Cotton Shop Brighton & Hove Albion FC BHAFC Classic Backprint Relaxed Zip Hoodie - Blue Blue Brighton & Hove Albion FC The BHAFC Classic Backprint Relaxed Zip Hoodie is the perfect year round outer layer for Albion fans. Crafted from a soft blue cotton blend, this zipped essential features an embroidered seagull on the chest and contrasting striped ribbing at the cuffs and hem. The look is completed with a bold, vintage-inspired collegiate print across the back, making it a standout layer for matches at the Amex or relaxed weekends in the city. Colour: Blue Size: Adult (XS-3XL) Relaxed fit Material: 80% Cotton, 20% Polyester Shop Brighton & Hove Albion FC BHAFC Mini Graphic Relaxed Tee - Navy Navy Brighton & Hove Albion FC The BHAFC Mini Graphic Relaxed Tee delivers a clean, understated take on club style. Crafted from soft navy cotton, it features a small white embroidered design that pairs BHAFC lettering with a seagull. Designed in a regular fit with a neat, minimal finish, it's an easy everyday essential for Albion supporters.
